# EditorsHub V4.6.0 — Native Android

Public GitHub release of the native Kotlin/Compose Android app built from commit
`d4ffa5237a08ec85c7a9d7e3e58fd3e60df49085` on `arena/be31b8e1-editorshub`.
This is not a PWA or WebView wrapper. Package: `com.editorshub`; version:
4.6.0 (code 19).

## Install

Download **`EditorsHub-debug.apk`**. It is the tested APK from successful CI run
[42642800416](https://github.com/spideycandy973-web/EditorsHub-/actions/runs/42642800416),
signed with the CI debug key. Android may refuse to update an installation
signed with a different key: back up projects, uninstall the older build if
needed, then install this APK. This is a debug-signed build, not a
production-signed Play Store artifact.

## What's in this release

- Reference-styled native Projects/home flow with search, date grouping,
  selection mode, batch duplicate/delete, and project creation.
- Real rendered project/effects thumbnails from the first active frame, with
  visible poster/fallbacks, atomic replacement of stale or zero-byte PNGs,
  cache-bypassing image loads, and off-main-thread Compose previews.
- Working keyframes from Transform/Effects diamonds, the Keyframes panel, the
  continuous graph editor, and timeline markers. Effect-parameter diamonds
  write real animated tracks and selected-layer keyframes toggle at the
  snapped local playhead.
- Output-viewport scaling, scaled pixel effects and project-space masks,
  full-frame `ARGB_8888` `DST_IN` masks, and synchronized draw/render paths.
- Existing native project, timeline, media/audio, XML import/export, effects,
  rendering, preview, and export functionality remains intact.

## Verification

GitHub Actions run 42642800416 passed `:app:testDebugUnitTest`, Android build
and packaging, 14 emulator instrumentation tests, and an emulator install/
launch smoke check. Its native home-screen capture was uploaded, but direct
artifact download from the release-preparation environment was blocked, so
pixel-clone fidelity to the supplied reference was not visually re-verified and
exact parity is not claimed.

## Clean-room boundary

Original Kotlin/Compose code and artwork only. No reference APK source, DEX,
proprietary artwork, fonts, audio, or re-signed APK are included. App branding
remains editable.
